title: First mixed valence cerium–organic trinuclear cluster [Ce3(OBut)10NO3] as a possible molecular switch: synthesis, structure and density functional calculations

synthesis.procedure: A hexane solution of [Ce(OBut)4(THF)2] (0.74 g, 1.28 mmol), Ce(OBut)3(NO3) (0.27 g, 0.64 mmol) and Sn(C5H3But2-1,3)Me3 (0.65 g, 1.92 mmol) was heated under reflux for 24 h. The dark brown solution was concentrated in vacuo, and green–brown crystals of 1 (0.57 g, 69%) formed at ambient temperature. Single crystals of the n-hexane solvate were obtained by crystallisation from hexane.

reagents.name: Sn(C5H3But2-1,3)Me3
reagents.amount: 0.65 g, 1.92 mmol (excess; three equivalents in eqn (1))

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The dark brown solution was concentrated in vacuo; green–brown crystals of 1 formed at ambient temperature. Single crystals of the n-hexane solvate were grown from hexane.

properties.summary: The UV–Vis spectrum of 1 in toluene shows strong absorptions at 220, 258, 278 and 336 nm. IR bands assigned to nitrate are reported, and 1H NMR shows paramagnetically shifted tert-butyl signals consistent with mixed-valence Ce(III)Ce(IV)2, but no bulk magnetic susceptibility data are given.
